I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in the same channel on Oct 14.

I found no later change to it in the channel or in the two public Central team files. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with Hollis.
